reuse.why: Adds the rule to the existing isWrittenByMonthAction predicate and detects the tag with the existing extractTagsFromText from shared/tags.

duplication.why: The decision is written once; only the data plumbing (group note join) is repeated in the two pre-existing parallel queries getBudgetData and getCategoriesWithGroupHidden.

placement.why: The rule sits in the single month-action selection predicate in budget/actions.ts, with the data fetched by the queries that already feed it.

scope.why: Only the predicate, the two feeding queries, the type and the tests change.

maintainability.why: A small named isFixedGroup check inside the one predicate every month-wide action consults is easy to own and extend.

one_place.where: isWrittenByMonthAction in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts (via isFixedGroup), used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero and all average actions
